primary_endpoint: Participants with treatment-emergent adverse events possibly or probably related to treatment, from first dose through Day 113 (±5 days).
safety_signal: Possibly/probably treatment-related TEAEs occurred in 0 participants at 25 mg, 0 at 50 mg, 1 at 100 mg, and 3 at 200 mg in cohorts 1–4; pooled placebo had 0. Serious AEs occurred in 1/6 participants in the 200 mg cohort 4b and none in the other reported groups; no deaths were reported.
